packageRules.description: Node 22.22.0 is the documented and supported floor; CI must test the floor rather than only the newest runtime.
@types/node must track the supported floor: engines.node is >=22.22.0, so the types stay on the Node 22 major.

The 6.x line is adopted (currently 6.0.3, verified to emit byte-identical dist output). TypeScript 7 is the deferred major compiler change: it needs its own migration with a dist-byte comparison, not a dependency bump.

Biome 2.6 is adopted. The configuration excludes Markdown prose and the renderer-input fixtures from the formatter, because those are not formatter-owned: the repository's docs are hand-maintained prose and the fixtures are test data whose bytes are renderer input.
